**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

§ 14.3 applies New York substantive law — the playbook's preferred choice of law. There is no arbitration clause anywhere in the agreement and no foreign or IBM-home-jurisdiction venue provision, so the walk-away scenario does not arise.

Noted but not flagged: the agreement lacks an express exclusive-venue designation (preferred: state and federal courts in New York County). Since no competing forum is imposed on Bluefly, this is a missing sub-mechanic rather than a material deviation, and it can be raised as a nice-to-have if the document is reopened for other reasons.
